System

Melee sweeps, server projectiles and hit deduplication

Spatial attacks use real 3D collision queries while sprites communicate their timing. The server owns the active window, projectile spawn and effect application, and records which targets have already been attempted for each execution.

Scope and player interaction

Spatial attacks use real 3D collision queries while sprites communicate their timing. The server owns the active window, projectile spawn and effect application, and records which targets have already been attempted for each execution.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase07committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Windup → Active → Recovery → Canceled → Finished

WBP_HUD observes results from URPGHitResolver. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Ability_Vanguard_Cleave. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
AttackExecutionId: server sequence scoped to attacker session
WindupSeconds, ActiveSeconds, RecoverySeconds: authored gameplay timing, independent of source PNG timing
MeleeQuery: swept capsule/box path, range and forward arc
AttemptedTargetIds: transient set for one execution; add before invoking effect
ProjectileId, SpawnOrigin, InitialVelocity, LifetimeSeconds: server-generated
DamageDefinitionId and EffectContext: immutable accepted attack parameters

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGHitResolverImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_HUDLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
BeginHitExecution(ValidatedAbilityContext) -> ExecutionId|InvalidState; server
AdvanceMeleeWindow(ExecutionId, PreviousTime, CurrentTime) -> HitAttempts; server timer/tick under explicit ownership
SpawnAuthoritativeProjectile(Context) -> ProjectileActor|SpawnBlocked; server
ResolveImpact(ExecutionId, TargetId) -> Applied|AlreadyAttempted|Blocked|TargetDead

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. GAS accepts the ability and creates one hit execution with a gameplay time interval and accepted stats/context.
  2. Server advances windup/active/recovery on its own clock. If a frame crosses the complete active interval, perform the bounded swept query for the crossed segment instead of losing the hit window.
  3. Normalize overlap/trace results to target actors, check collision/LOS/faction and insert target identity into AttemptedTargetIds before invoking damage.
  4. For ranged attacks, spawn a server-owned projectile with collision and movement, ignore the instigator and resolve blocking impact once; clients may predict a cosmetic projectile that is reconciled to the accepted one.
  5. Damage/healing effects apply through the one GAS effect path. Cosmetic PaperZD notifies may add sounds but cannot call ResolveImpact or release authoritative cooldowns.
  6. Cancel execution on death/interruption/invalid avatar and destroy or invalidate remaining projectiles under their authored lifetime policy.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create ARPGProjectile from Actor with a collision root and ProjectileMovementComponent; use a separate noncolliding visual child. Set server replication/velocity policy and lifetime.
  2. Create BP_Projectile_TrainingArrow and BP_Projectile_ArcSpark with their visual definitions; no arrows or magic effects are claimed in the supplied ZIP.
  3. Add URPGHitResolver to authoritative characters and expose only debug geometry/tuning via definitions; clients cannot submit arbitrary effect specs.
  4. Create the initial melee and projectile ability definitions with explicit active windows, origins and query shapes. Origin comes from validated avatar/weapon anchor, not the client mouse ray start.
  5. Place dummies at near/far distances and a blocking wall in L_NetworkLab. Reopen GAS abilities to call the resolver at gameplay times and presentation adapter to observe the same execution ID.

Reopen Phase07 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / Dummy_Near / Dummy_Far / ProjectileWall. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Two components on one target overlap -> one damage attempt per execution.
Packet replay or duplicated overlap -> AlreadyAttempted, no extra damage.
Projectile hits wall before enemy -> destroyed/blocked; no damage through wall.
Attacker dies in windup -> Canceled; missed animation completion cannot leave a permanent attack lock.
Client sends impossible muzzle origin -> InvalidOrigin; server uses approved location or rejects.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Training melee windup 0.15 s, active 0.10 s, recovery 0.30 s; arrow speed 1800 cm/s, lifetime 3 s. Values are proposals. Lag compensation is not silently added; evaluate a bounded server-history approach only after baseline measurements.

Trace execution IDs, attempted targets, collision hits, authoritative origin and rejection reasons. Client visual hit feedback distinguishes predicted contact from confirmed damage.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
